en: Sepia-toned photograph of a vintage city bus at a bus stop. The bus has rounded 1960s-style bodywork with twin headlamps on each side and a large front grille. Route number 31 is displayed above the windscreen. A bus stop pole with a timetable is visible in the foreground. The license plate on the bus reads "GC-84-40" and a circular logo with text is painted on the side of the vehicle. Residential buildings with tiled roofs appear in the background.
